holdings.name: Sai Life Sciences Ltd.

what_changed.text: Sai Life Sciences reported Q1 FY27 revenue of ₹554 crore with net profit of ₹73 crore, down sequentially from ₹104 crore in March 2026.
The company scheduled its board meeting for November 5, 2026, to review and approve Q2 and half-year unaudited results.
Jefferies highlighted the company among selected Indian CRDMO players well placed to capture international orders.

holdings.why_it_matters: Sai Life Sciences is the fund's top holding at 5.14% weight. It contributed 0.474% to 3-month performance despite a 1-month pullback of -9.73%, maintaining a strong position in the fund's 20.1% healthcare basket.

watch.text: Outcome of the board meeting on November 5, 2026, considering Q2 results.

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: Zomato scheduled its board meeting and earnings conference call for October 21, 2026, to announce Q2 FY26 results.
The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration initiated action and suspended warehouse licences for units including Blinkit and Zomato Hyperpure over expired food handling.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 4.38% weight in the portfolio, Zomato was the highest 3-month contributor adding 0.591% with a 13.5% return, serving as a primary performance anchor within the fund's 9.5% technology exposure.

watch.text: Financial results and operational commentary from the board meeting and earnings call on October 21, 2026.
Regulatory and operational fallout from the Maharashtra FDA warehouse licence suspensions.

holdings.name: Aditya Infotech Ltd.

what_changed.text: Aditya Infotech completed a Qualified Institutional Placement raising approximately ₹1,500 crore through the allotment of 43.27 lakh equity shares at ₹3,467 per share on September 25, 2026.
Motilal Oswal highlighted a strong growth runway for the company in mid-October 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 3.98% of the fund, the stock delivered a 12.43% 3-month return and contributed 0.495%, reinforcing technology sector gains alongside Zomato.

watch.text: Utilization of the ₹1,500 crore raised from the institutional placement.

holdings.name: Amber Enterprises India Ltd

what_changed.text: Material subsidiary IL JIN Electronics agreed to acquire the remaining 40% stake in Power-One and the remaining 1.5% in Ascent Circuits via share swaps to make both wholly owned.
IL JIN Electronics appointed Satendra Singh as CEO and Whole-Time Director effective October 16, 2026, following the cessation of Sanjay Kumar Arora.

holdings.why_it_matters: Amber Enterprises holds a 3.69% weight and was a primary detractor over the last 3 months, falling -14.56% and shaving 0.537% off fund returns within the 18.3% consumer discretionary sleeve.

watch.text: Integration and completion of full ownership acquisitions for Power-One and Ascent Circuits.

holdings.name: Krishna Institute Of Medical Sciences Ltd

what_changed.text: The board approved acquisitions of up to a 51% stake in Sarvottam Health Care for ₹80 crore and up to 22% in Splendid Hospitals for ₹40 crore.
The company clarified metrics for Sarvottam Health Care showing a profit after tax of ₹7.06 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 3.42% weight, KIMS detracted 0.50% from fund performance over 3 months as its share price dropped -14.61%, compounding losses within the fund's heavy 20.1% healthcare allocation.

watch.text: Closing of the Sarvottam Health Care acquisition targeted by October 31, 2026.

holdings.name: Interglobe Aviation Ltd

what_changed.text: Customs authorities issued an order demanding additional duty on aviation turbine fuel imports alongside a ₹3.5 crore penalty.
The central government informed the Supreme Court that rules to regulate airfares have been finalised.
CRISIL maintained IndiGo's credit ratings of AA- and A1+ on rating watch with developing implications for ₹9,000 crore bank facilities.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 3.08% of the portfolio, IndiGo dropped -10.7% over 3 months, dragging fund returns by -0.33% amidst regulatory and cost headwinds in industrials.

watch.text: Implementation and commercial impact of airfare regulation rules finalized by the government.
Resolution of CRISIL's rating watch on bank facilities.

holdings.name: Max Healthcare Institute Ltd

what_changed.text: The stock experienced a steep decline of around 20% in three weeks to touch a multi-year low by mid-October 2026.
Hospital sector shares faced sentiment shifts following government moves regarding a 30% cancer drug price cap.
CARE reaffirmed Max Healthcare's AA+ stable credit rating and upgraded subsidiary Crosslay Remedies' facilities.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.98% portfolio weight, Max Healthcare was the single largest detractor over 3 months, posting a -22.38% return and subtracting -0.667% from the fund.

watch.text: Adjourned NCLT hearing regarding Kalinga Hospital scheduled for October 29, 2026.
Index inclusion adjustments ahead of the March 2027 review.

holdings.name: Prestige Estates Projects Ltd

what_changed.text: Prestige reported H1 FY27 pre-sales of ₹13,804.3 crore and consummated the first tranche of CPPIB's investment in its hospitality business PHVL for ₹1,500 crore.
Disputes regarding the Turf View project were settled, with the Bombay High Court restoring de-registration and promoter change orders.

expected.text: Q2 pre-sales were expected by Nomura and Morgan Stanley, with actual pre-sales coming in above their estimates at ₹7,225 crore.

seeing.text: Reported Q2 FY27 pre-sales reached ₹7,225 crore, beating brokerage estimates from Nomura and Morgan Stanley.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 2.73% weight, Prestige detracted -0.324% over 3 months due to an 11.87% price decline, though operational updates demonstrated strong quarterly bookings beat.

watch.text: Deployment of funds from the ₹3,000 crore total hospitality transaction with CPPIB.

holdings.name: Paradeep Phosphates Ltd

what_changed.text: Paradeep Phosphates expanded product offerings with the launch of Navratna DAP.
Fertiliser manufacturers including Paradeep faced scrutiny regarding El Nino impacts ahead of the Rabi cropping season.
Raj Kumar Agrawal was appointed as an Additional Independent Director on October 13, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Paradeep Phosphates holds a 2.44% fund weight, delivering a 4.92% return over 3 months and providing steady performance in the materials basket.

watch.text: Market acceptance of Navratna DAP during the approaching Rabi planting season.

holdings.name: Craftsman Automation Ltd

what_changed.text: Craftsman Automation set its board meeting for October 28, 2026, to review Q2 FY26 unaudited financial results.
Tax authorities issued a GST demand order on September 30, 2026, seeking ₹68.72 lakh plus interest and equal penalty over excess input tax credit.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.34% allocation, Craftsman gained 20.37% over 3 months and contributed 0.477%, mitigating losses seen in other consumer discretionary holdings.

watch.text: Q2 FY26 financial results to be declared on October 28, 2026.

portfolio.statement: Invesco India Small Cap Fund posted a 3-month return of -1.40%, heavily impacted by sharp drops in healthcare and discretionary holdings despite strength in technology and engineering.
interp: The fund's heavy 20.1% healthcare exposure faced substantial headwinds from sharp drops in Max Healthcare (-22.38%) and KIMS (-14.61%), offsetting gains from Sai Life Sciences.
Strong quarterly contributions from technology holdings Zomato (+13.50%) and Aditya Infotech (+12.43%) were diluted by weakness across hospital operators, aviation, and consumer electronics.
portfolio.line: Healthcare drawdowns and consumer discretionary weakness offset strong momentum in platform technology and precision manufacturing.

drivers.text: Zomato delivered a 13.50% return, contributing +0.591% to portfolio performance over 3 months.
Aditya Infotech added +0.495% following an institutional capital raise of ₹1,500 crore.
Max Healthcare detracted -0.667% as its stock plunged -22.38% over the quarter.
Amber Enterprises shaved -0.537% off returns, falling -14.56% across the 3-month window.

themes.title: Platform and Tech Services Expansion
themes.text: Core technology holdings saw strong share gains and active capital formation, with Aditya Infotech completing a ₹1,500 crore QIP and Zomato delivering solid top-line contribution.

themes.title: Healthcare Division Under Pricing Pressure
themes.text: While CRDMO player Sai Life Sciences advanced, hospital chains suffered substantial pullbacks amidst cancer drug price caps and sector-wide sell-offs.
holdings: Krishna Institute Of Medical Sciences Ltd

macro.why: Government rules capping cancer drug prices and finalizing airfare caps directly impacted margin sentiment for hospital operators and airlines.
Fertiliser volume demand and seasonal performance face scrutiny under El Nino conditions going into the Rabi cycle.

priced_in.text: Prestige Estates pre-sales momentum and ₹7,225 crore Q2 bookings were received positively by brokerages after beating estimates.
Sai Life Sciences' multi-quarter market gains reflect its positioning as an export-focused CRDMO provider.

could_change.title: Warehouse and Supply Chain Compliance
could_change.text: Regulatory probes and licence suspensions by the Maharashtra FDA across quick commerce and dark store units could influence fulfillment costs.

could_change.title: Hospital Realization Adjustments
could_change.text: Operational adjustments following mandated caps on select critical treatment drug markups may alter hospital EBITDA projections.

portfolio.risk_note: A concentrated 42.7% combined allocation across Financials and Healthcare leaves the portfolio sensitive to domestic regulatory pricing caps and private clinical margin pressures.
